what: A smoothly drifting random control signal that never repeats, for slow, natural-feeling movement.
how: At each step the module picks a new random level and glides smoothly to it. RATE sets how often it picks a new one. Patch the output into a cutoff, pitch or any other CV input to make that setting drift on its own.

ins.rate: A control signal that changes the speed. Each 1.0 of signal doubles the RATE (an octave), -1.0 halves it.

outs.out: The drifting signal, between -DEPTH and +DEPTH (bipolar). Good for pitch or filter wobbles.
outs.uni: The same signal squeezed to sit around 0.5, so it stays between 0 and 1 at full DEPTH (less depth, narrower). Good for volume or things that cannot go negative.

knobs.rate: How fast it wanders, 0.01 to 40 times a second. Slow is a gentle drift.
knobs.depth: The size of the wandering, 0 to 1, for both outputs. At 0 there is no movement.

try: Patch WANDER's out into SVF's cutoff (turn the CV knob up to the middle), with VCO into SVF's in and SVF's lp into OUT. Hold a note and hear the filter drift on its own.
